description: Document Comparison - Side-by-side diff for markdown documents, metadata comparison for any documents, version-to-version diff. Returns structured diff data and HTML rendering.
steps: Create app/services/comparison.py with a ComparisonService class: (a) compare_metadata(doc_a: Document, doc_b: Document) -> dict - field-by-field comparison of metadata (filename, size, type, status, created_at, updated_at, keywords, summary). Returns dict with fields showing values from both docs and whether they differ. (b) compare_markdown(content_a: str, content_b: str) -> dict - generates unified diff using Python's difflib. Returns dict with: unified_diff (string), additions_count, deletions_count, similarity_ratio (SequenceMatcher). (c) compare_versions(db, document_id, version_a_num, version_b_num) -> dict - loads markdown content of two versions (if available) and returns both metadata comparison and content diff. (d) generate_diff_html(content_a: str, content_b: str, label_a: str, label_b: str) -> str - uses difflib.HtmlDiff to generate a side-by-side HTML table showing differences.

Create app/schemas/comparison.py with Pydantic schemas: MetadataComparisonResponse (fields dict showing both values), ContentDiffResponse (unified_diff, additions, deletions, similarity_ratio), ComparisonResponse (metadata_comparison, content_diff nullable, diff_html nullable), CompareRequest (doc_a_id, doc_b_id as query params).

Create app/api/compare.py with APIRouter (tags=['compare']): (a) GET /api/documents/compare?doc_a={id}&doc_b={id} - compares two different documents. Returns metadata comparison and content diff if both have markdown. (b) GET /api/documents/{document_id}/versions/diff?version_a={n}&version_b={n} - compares two versions of the same document. Returns content diff. (c) GET /api/documents/compare/html?doc_a={id}&doc_b={id} - returns an HTML page with side-by-side highlighted comparison (uses Jinja2 template or inline HTML via difflib.HtmlDiff).

Create app/templates/compare.html - a Jinja2 template showing side-by-side diff with Tailwind CSS styling. Shows document metadata at top, then diff below with additions highlighted in green and deletions in red.
Register the compare router in app/api/router.py.

Create tests/test_compare.py with tests for: (a) Metadata comparison shows field differences correctly. (b) Markdown diff shows additions and deletions. (c) Similarity ratio is calculated correctly. (d) HTML diff endpoint returns valid HTML. (e) Comparing non-existent documents returns 404. (f) Version diff works for same document's versions.
acceptance_criteria: Markdown content diff shows unified diff with additions/deletions count
HTML comparison endpoint returns styled side-by-side diff
Version-to-version comparison works within a single document
All existing tests continue to pass
New tests in test_compare.py all pass
verification: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
findings: All 592 tests pass (576 existing + 16 new). Compare router registered before documents_router to avoid any potential path conflicts. Used inline HTML generation instead of Jinja2 template rendering for the /compare/html endpoint to avoid needing to configure Jinja2 template lookup in the router.
